summary: Iteration 9 — MutationObserver 'wasNearBottom' guard CONFIRMED WORKING. All 4 critical scroll tests PASS. The fix in ChatApp.js lines 617-631 successfully: (1) opens chat at bottom, (2) allows scroll-up to history without reset, (3) auto-scrolls when sending message from history position, (4) DOM mutations while reading history do NOT reset scroll. All regression tests PASS.

issues: CAVEAT (not a bug): CometChat's built-in scrollToBottomOnNewMessages={true} prop is still active on CometChatMessageList. If another user sends a message while the doctor is reading history, CometChat's own prop may auto-scroll. This is separate from our custom MutationObserver fix and is CometChat's managed behavior. The custom MutationObserver guard (our fix) is working correctly and does NOT reset scroll for DOM mutations (receipts, timestamps, status updates) while user is reading history.

key_fix_confirmed.guard: const distFromBottom = s.scrollHeight - s.scrollTop - s.clientHeight; const wasNearBottom = distFromBottom < 150; if (wasNearBottom) { cancelAnimationFrame(rafId); rafId = requestAnimationFrame(scrollToBottom); }
key_fix_confirmed.effect: DOM mutations (receipts, timestamps, online status) no longer reset scrollTop when user is reading history (scrollTop=0). Guard only allows auto-scroll when user was within 150px of bottom.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider whether CometChat's scrollToBottomOnNewMessages={true} should be changed to false so that new messages from other users also respect the wasNearBottom guard. Currently our custom observer handles background mutations; CometChat's prop handles actual new message events.
